disclosures.text: A first transport device with a first circulating transport means
A second transport device with a second circulating transport means
Goods are receivable between the circulating transport means
Goods are transported by the circulating transport means
Each circulating transport means is guided around at least two deflecting wheels
At least one adjusting device is provided to adjust a position of at least one deflecting wheel
The adjusting device has a displaceable support
A deflecting wheel is rotatably arranged on the displaceable support
A first tensioning means biases the support in a predetermined direction

A transport device for goods with two circulating transport means, where goods are received and transported between them, each circulating means guided by at least two deflecting wheels, and an adjusting device adjusts a deflecting wheel's
The adjusting device has a locking means
The locking means at least partially prevents return of the support against the predetermined direction
The locking means comprises a ratchet mechanism
The circulating transport means is a transport chain
The tensioning means biases the carrier with a force less than 200N
The tensioning means biases the carrier with a force less than 150N
The tensioning means biases the carrier with a force less than 100N
The tensioning means biases the carrier with a force less than 80N
The tensioning means biases the carrier with a force less than 60N
The tensioning means biases the carrier with a force less than 50N
The tensioning means biases the carrier with a force greater than 10N
The tensioning means biases the carrier with a force greater than 20N
The support is displaceable in a rectilinear direction
The adjusting device has a movable actuator
The adjusting device has a rotatable actuator
The actuator acts mechanically on the support
The adjusting device has a tensioning means that loads the actuator in a predetermined tensioning direction
The actuator is rotatable about a predetermined axis of rotation
